mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right brightness and color temperature for my deck lights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right brightness and color temperature depends on the desired ambiance and functionality. Brighter lights are suitable for task areas like grilling, while dimmer, warmer lights create a cozy atmosphere. Color temperatures, measured in Kelvins (K), range from warm white (2700K-3000K) to cool white (4000K-5000K). Consider how you intend to use your deck and which areas require more focused light versus general illumination. We can help you select options that balance aesthetics and practicality.
